short: Bound the rank lost at a filtration cut

statements.markdown: The proof runs level by level. For each τ ∈ [0, HH]: cut each N i at the step of its Harder–Narasimhan filtration of slope µ̄ − τ + h i ; a Markov inequality (frameB_share) shows that the parts cut away have at most the share u F /(u F + τ ) of the total rank;

lean.name: Formalism.HN.frameB_share
lean.plain: Bound the rank lost at a filtration cut
lean.note: For positive u, this bounds the share of slope entries below the cut. Theorem F converts their count to lost rank and handles u = 0 separately. The conclusion bounds the fraction of slopes below the threshold by u divided by u plus tau.
